sentences.text: Sir Lucian Grainge serves as Chairman and CEO of Universal Music Group NV, having spent his entire career in the music industry.

Over four decades he has signed and worked with many worldwide stars, including ABBA, Jay Z, Elton John, Katy Perry, Queen, Rihanna, The Rolling Stones, Sam Smith, U2 and Amy Winehouse, pioneering new approaches to the signing and development of the world's most successful recording artists and songwriters.
